structured.answer: Open an account at פסגות and buy ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D) (5139282) every month. The page says about 86,492 ₪ in today's money after 10 years, but that's with its default 10,000 start + 500/month, not my 30,000.

stuck.why: The big 86,492 ₪ says 'הבחירה שלכם · הזול' but doesn't name the bank or the fund. I had to scroll to find out what I'd picked.
'1 ₪ יותר', '58 ₪ פחות', '14 ₪ יותר'. More or less than what? I couldn't tell.
It shows '0 ₪' and also '1,057 ₪'. Is the account free or does it cost 1,057?
Too many funds and banks that look alike, each with lots of coloured tags. I got lost and stopped scrolling.

used: Heading 'איפה ואיך הכי זול להשקיע במדד, לאורך זמן'
Fund card 'ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D) 5139282', דמי ניהול 0%
Red minus numbers on the other banks (לאומי −3,096 ... מיטב −22,985)
skimmed: Coloured cost bar and its legend at top of screen 2
Fund list with tags on screens 2–4
Bank list descriptions ('לא בחישוב מחיר אחר ל...')
'מה הכי משנה את מה שיישאר לכם' heading
skipped: Inflation button and the grey line about exchange rate and date
Paragraph 'כל החשבונות' explaining how prices are calculated
Explanation 'למה חלק מהקרנות בלי מחיר בפסגות' and חוקים וכללים link
not_found: The result for my own 30,000 ₪ (only the default 10,000 was shown)
A plain 'first step: open account here' button next to the big result
The name of the chosen bank/fund on the first screen

findings.what: The big result 86,492 ₪ doesn't say which bank and fund it's for. You have to scroll to find out.
פסגות row shows both 0 ₪ and 1,057 ₪. Unclear if the account costs money.
Summary numbers '1 ₪ יותר / 58 ₪ פחות / 14 ₪ יותר' with no 'compared to what'
Every fund has 3–5 coloured tags full of jargon (צוברת, נטרול מט"ח, מס גם על שינוי המטבע). Too much to read on a phone.
Lists are very long and look alike. Easy to get lost.
A range like 'בין +2,212 ל־−23,766' is scary and not explained next to it
Default start amount is 10,000, so the first big number isn't about my money unless I edit it
